_comment: CODE -> SPEC MAP of this skill. A PERSON writes it, not a generator.
A spec is an exact FILE, never a folder or a glob (the hook compares by path equality).
It goes by FILE/SUBSYSTEM, not wide: a rule with several specs requires ALL of them, so
'scripts/** -> three docs' would force touching the three for a fix in dashboard.js.
Synchronisation between documents is watched by tests/test-structure.mjs, not by this map.
Keys starting with _ are ignored: this is a comment, not a rule.
